Herman Or Friendship Starter
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 12:14am

Ingredients




1 cup Sugar
 cup Warm water
2 env active dry yeast
2 cups Milk
2 cups Flour

Preparation

1 Sprinkle one tablespoon sugar over warm water. Sprinkle yeast over this and let stand in warm place until doubled in size, about 10 minutes. Mix milk, remaining sugar, flour and yeast mixture. Place in plastic or glass containter about the size of a 5-quar ice cream bucket. Stir, using only a wooden sppon or paddle, as metal retards growth.
